# Genuine Optimum

> Genuine Optimum is a software house working on applied AI and data infrastructure. We take on the whole system: the model, the data it runs on, and the product people use it through. We also build and run our own software products for specific industries.

## Products

- [Dispatch OS](https://www.genuineoptimum.com/products/dispatch-os): Back-office software for US truck dispatchers. Upload a rate confirmation (ratecon) and the load details and earnings are filled in automatically. Carrier profiles, gross revenue by week, month and year, automatic dispatch fees, and invoice generation for brokers and drivers.
- [AI Voice Agent](https://www.genuineoptimum.com/products/ai-voice-agent): Answers inbound phone calls in natural speech, qualifies the caller, books the appointment and hands off to a human with full context.
- [Construction Finance Suite](https://www.genuineoptimum.com/products/construction-finance-suite): Budgets against actuals, expenses, inventory and purchase approvals across every build project in one place.
- [All products](https://www.genuineoptimum.com/products)

## What we build

See [Capabilities](https://www.genuineoptimum.com/capabilities) for the full list: AI models and agents, AI engineering, harness engineering, data systems, web development, app development, CMS and internal software, dashboards and BI, automation and integration, cloud engineering, and DevOps.

## Services

- [Web Development](https://www.genuineoptimum.com/services/web-development): Fast, scalable, conversion-focused websites and web platforms (React, Next.js, e-commerce).
- [SEO](https://www.genuineoptimum.com/services/seo): Technical SEO, on-page optimization, local SEO, and link authority development for organic growth.
- [Custom Applications](https://www.genuineoptimum.com/services/custom-applications): Mobile, web, and SaaS applications, plus internal business systems.
- [AI & Data Systems](https://www.genuineoptimum.com/services/ai-data-systems): AI chatbots, workflow automation, data dashboards, and predictive models.
- [Services overview](https://www.genuineoptimum.com/services)
